prompts.name: loading-impeller
prompts.prompt: Edit this exact illustration. Preserve the exact scene, camera, framing, object positions and sizes, background geometry, lighting of surroundings, cargo/parts/cable gap. Change ONLY the visibility and simplification of the SUBMARINE. Make its rounded silhouette much stronger at128x64: broad clean solid WHITE hull top and upper side against black water, solid clean dark belly, a bright uninterrupted lower rim separating hull from water if necessary. Distinct compact conning tower, three clear black portholes with thin clean white outer rings, crisp simple fins and propeller. Remove MOST stipple, rivets and small marks from the sub body; retain just one SMALL broad curved shade patch near its underside. Bold readable volumetric forms, not a flat outlined icon. Do not lighten or add dither to backgrounds or other objects. Keep all non-submarine artwork unchanged. No people, lettering, UI or extra subjects. Keep the large clean replacement impeller and its straps/cradle exactly as-is; only clarify the underlying submarine hull, tower and tail. The impeller remains the cargo focal point.

prompts.name: loading-internal-correction
prompts.prompt: Correct this exact loading illustration: cargo is carried in the submarine's INTERNAL hold, NEVER on deck. Remove the giant impeller and all cradle/cargo straps from atop the submarine. Show a scaled-down clean replacement impeller in a dock-side loading cradle beside an open cargo hatch/loading access on the submarine, near the right-hand dock. The part must plausibly FIT THROUGH that hatch into the internal hull: about a quarter of hull length or smaller, recognizable hub and broad curved vanes. It is in process of loading from the dock, not permanently mounted outside. Preserve the exact submarine position/scale, rounded clean WHITE hull side/top, clear black portholes, distinct tower/tail/prop, existing berth/gantry/dock and lighting/camera/composition. The vacated hull top should be a clean continuous curve. If necessary simplify/move only the part and its small dock cradle to make this internal-loading relationship clear. No deck cargo, no strapped exterior objects. Keep all other surroundings unchanged; black-white balanced shading and no added body stipple. No people, text, labels or UI.

selectionNote: Earlier sources retained. Current loading uses internal hold; current submarines use strong solid shapes. Intermediate extra-sub artifact is not displayed.

nativeRendering.method: Balanced v3 unchanged; integer source-cell RGB area average, threshold96 exterior/127.5 cable interior, +/-40 middle-tone window,2x2 ordered25/50/75%. No local ROI modification needed: source hulls now have solid light masses.
nativeRendering.rendererRuntime: Node.js built-ins; run from repository root
